title: Prep the decision on what wakes marketing up
ask: Marketing is dormant by standing instruction and nothing anywhere says what would turn it back on, so it is off by inertia rather than by decision. Prep a decision card the CEO can rule on in a minute: two or three concrete triggers with a recommendation — a date, a public build, a number of players, whatever is actually checkable from here — and what each one would commit the studio to doing once it fires. Do not ask him an open question; give him options.
first_action: Read the dormancy record in hq/data/pillars.json and ITCH_PAGE.md, then write the card into hq/data/decisions/.
